summary: The approved Round 2 minor is resolved. The diagnostic test now inspects every emitted link, source_name, and title character directly and rejects all Unicode control categories, including literal newlines and carriage returns; JSON escaping can no longer hide the defect. Removing the single-line normalization while leaving control characters in any emitted field would fail this assertion, so the test is mutation-closing for the reported regression. The targeted diagnostic test and all scoped Task 2 unit/corpus, extractor, and integration tests pass (280 tests and 71 subtests). No current-task defects remain, and this scoped wave found no pre-existing debt or adjacent improvement to record.
